opening.argument: The video presents a practical walkthrough of Google Opinion Rewards, beginning with account setup and continuing through survey participation. The demonstrated reward is Google Play credit usable for paid apps, not a promise of cash or an immediate return. The displayed Google Opinion Rewards screen shows a ₹298.43 balance alongside a message that no survey is currently available, reinforcing an ordinary platform-reward process.
